enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Place arm under pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Sleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning hygiene routine: washing, brushing teeth, etc.
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Squeeze toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth with water. Spit into sink. Wash face with water. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out bowl and pan. Close cabinet. Place bowl on counter. Crack eggs into bowl. Whisk eggs with fork. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off induction cooker. Pick up plate. Transfer eggs to plate. Open refrigerator. Take out juice. Close refrigerator. Pour juice into glass. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Drink juice. Pick up plate and glass. Walk to sink. Rinse plate and glass. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Close closet. Lay clothes on bed. Take off pajama top. Take off pajama bottoms. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Walk to mirror. Comb hair. Pick up bag. Check phone. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office door. Open door.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit: coordinating community programs and administrative tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to desk. Sit down. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open email program. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Make phone calls. Write notes. Attend meeting. Take notes. Discuss with colleagues. Return to desk. Type report. Print document. File documents. Organize files. Use computer.

Walk to lunch area. Open refrigerator. Take out lunch bag. Close refrigerator. Sit at table. Open lunch bag. Take out sandwich. Take out fruit. Eat sandwich. Eat fruit. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Throw away trash. Walk outside. Walk around block. Return to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at nonprofit: coordinating community programs and administrative tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open computer. Check email. Make phone calls. Meet with community partners. Take notes. Update database. Write reports. Attend video conference. Collaborate with team. Print materials. Distribute materials. Organize event logistics. Confirm venue. Send emails. Review budget. File paperwork.
Leave office. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house.

Walk into kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Place on counter. Open cabinet. Take out cutting board and knife. Close cabinet. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir vegetables. Add seasoning. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher.

Pick up dishes from table. Carry to sink. Scrape food into trash. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter with sponge. Wipe table with cloth. Sweep floor with broom. Pick up dustpan. Dispose of trash. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV or using phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote control. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Scroll through social media. Check messages. Reply to messages. Put down phone. Continue watching TV. Pick up remote. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on personal computer or personal projects
enriched_activities.desc: Walk into bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Enter password. Open project file. Type on keyboard. Use mouse. Check email. Write document. Save file. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Stand up.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk into bedroom. Pick up book from nightstand. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Turn page. Close book. Place book on nightstand. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up to chin. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Place arm under pillow. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn to back. Sleep.
